'''''Swift Return'''''<ref name="Cat and Mouse Ep Guide" /> was a retrofitted<ref name="Class" /> [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]]<ref name="Cat and Mouse" /> that served as a [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]]<ref name="Cat and Mouse Ep Guide" /> in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|Navy]].<ref name="Cat and Mouse" /> ''Swift Return'' was destroyed in battle with the acclaimed [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Trench/Legends|Trench]] prior to the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]]<ref name="Cat and Mouse Ep Guide" /> of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="Date" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Swift Return'' first appeared in "[[Cat and Mouse]],"<ref name="Cat and Mouse" /> an episode of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] which aired on [[March 26]] [[2010]],<ref name="Cat and Mouse Ep Guide" /> as a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] readout. Its name was written in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] in the episode,<ref name="Cat and Mouse" /> and the English translation was confirmed in the corresponding [[The Clone Wars Episode Guides|episode guide]] on [[StarWars.com]].<ref name="Cat and Mouse Ep Guide" />
